title: 第11章 杀人立威众仙惊截阐二教弟子现第12章 青渊战多宝剑道与剑道之间的对决
slug: 洪荒截教大师兄收徒就能变强
lines: 这群修士莫名其妙的来到我们道场前叫嚣大骂，还突然袭击师兄与我，还请师父做主！
无支祁面色一喜，委屈的讲述事情。
“此间事情我不会让你们委屈，放心。”
随后凌厉的目光扫视全场。
洪荒生灵并无什么道德礼仪可言，观念便是物竞天择丛林法则，一个个都是心高气傲、桀骜不驯的主，狂妄的很。
全场所有人在青渊那般犀利目光下。
恐惧的埋入人群中，恨不得转身就逃。
他算是拜入截教最早的那一批，从截教几百人到现在几千人，都知道门里最早拜师的青渊、多宝两人谁最厉害谁最没用。
谁不知大师兄青渊老师讲什么他听不懂，剑道、阵法、炼丹……不论正道旁门术法、神通手段，没有一样能够参悟至高深地步，练不出什么厉害手段。
这般恐怖剑意究竟是什么情况？！
如此杀伐剑意如同森罗绝境般毁灭意识冻结肉身元神，仿佛一个意念便能抹杀在场任何生灵！
连他这般天生善于逃遁的生灵。
连多宝师兄都无这般剑意，青渊怎么可能会有？
难不成……是青渊一直在藏拙不成？！
content_en:
"Master!
This group of monks came to our dojo out of nowhere, yelling and cursing, and suddenly attacked my senior brother and me, asking Master to make the decision!
! "
I saw Qingyuan coming.
Wuzhiqi looked happy and told the story aggrievedly.
And Yun Zhongzi was determined in his heart.
Salute to Qingyuan: "I've met Master."
"Well, no need to be polite."
"I won't make you feel wronged about this matter, don't worry."
Qingyuan comforted the two apprentices.
Then his sharp eyes scanned the whole place.
In this era.
There is no moral etiquette for the creatures in the primitive world. Their concept is the law of natural selection. Every one of them is arrogant, unruly and arrogant.
Can be biased.
Everyone in the audience was under Qing Yuan's sharp gaze.
No one dared to look at each other.
Especially Dingguangxian.
Buried in the crowd in fear, I wanted to turn around and run away.
In my heart, I was extremely surprised.
This, this is Qingyuan? !
How is that possible!
How could this be Qingyuan? !
He was one of the first batch to join the Jie Cult. From a few hundred to the Jie Cult now, there are thousands of them now. Everyone knows who is the most powerful and who is the least useful, Qing Yuan and Duo Bao, the first disciples in the sect.
Who doesn't know what senior brother Qing Yuan is saying that he can't understand? Swordsmanship, formations, alchemy... no matter whether it's the right path, side sects, or magical means, none of them can be understood to a profound level, and they can't practice any powerful means.
Therefore.
He chose Senior Brother Duobao.
But today...
What is the situation with such terrifying sword intent? !
Such a killing sword intent is like a desperate situation, destroying consciousness and freezing the body and soul, as if a single thought can obliterate any living thing present!
Even a creature like him who is naturally good at escaping.
Don't dare to move!
Even Senior Brother Duobao doesn't have such sword intent, how could Qingyuan have it?
Could it be that... Qingyuan has been hiding his clumsiness? !
title_en: Chapter 11: Killing to establish power and all the immortals are shocked. Disciples of the second sect of Chan appear. Chapter 12: Qingyuan fights against Duobao and the showdown between swordsmanship.
